subheadline: Unlock every filter and preset, and support development.

promotions.title: Filter Friday
promotions.body: Every Friday we give away about 10 yearly Pro promo codes. Subscribe to our mailing list so you find out if you won.

promotions.title: Early Bird Pricing
promotions.body: The price of Opta Pro goes up over time, so the earliest subscribers pay the least. Yearly: €5 for the first 2 weeks, €10 for the next 2, €15 for the next 3, then €20. Monthly: €0.99, €1.99, €2.99, then €3.99. Lifetime: €15, €25, €35, then €45.

promotions.title: Tag Us, Win a Code
promotions.body: Tag us in a post shot with Opta to enter our weekly raffle for Pro promo codes.
